checks.s: The NDA is structured as a mutual agreement, with each party designated as both a Discloser and a Recipient throughout the operative provisions.
The defined terms Discloser, Recipient, and Confidential Information consistently apply to both parties throughout the NDA.
The NDA identifies Verdana Holdings, Inc. as a corporation organized under the laws of Delaware or as a Delaware corporation.
The NDA identifies Castellan Data Systems, LLC as a limited liability company organized under the laws of Delaware or as a Delaware limited liability company.
The NDA gives Verdana's principal office address as 400 Ridgeview Plaza, Suite 1200, Wilmington, DE 19801.
The NDA gives Castellan's principal office address as 8550 Meridian Park Drive, 4th Floor, Reston, VA 20190.
The recitals describe the Transaction as Verdana's potential acquisition of a 72% membership-interest stake in Castellan.
The recitals do not state an enterprise value of $385,000,000 or any other financial terms, including equity value, revenue, EBITDA, or multiples.
The definition of Confidential Information specifically enumerates financial statements and projections or financial forecasts.
The definition of Confidential Information specifically enumerates both source code and algorithms.
The definition of Confidential Information specifically enumerates trade secrets.
The definition of Confidential Information specifically enumerates customer lists and/or supplier lists.
The definition of Confidential Information specifically enumerates employee data, employee information, or personnel data.
The definition of Confidential Information specifically enumerates government-contract terms and references ITAR/EAR-controlled technical data.
The definition of Confidential Information specifically enumerates deal-related communications, deal communications, transaction-related correspondence, or substantially equivalent language.
The NDA excludes information that is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the Recipient from Confidential Information.
The NDA excludes information already known to the Recipient without restriction before disclosure from Confidential Information.
The NDA excludes information independently developed by the Recipient without use of the Discloser's Confidential Information from Confidential Information.
The NDA excludes information received from a third party not under an obligation of confidentiality, or received without breach, from Confidential Information.
The NDA specifies that confidentiality obligations survive for 3 years measured from the date of disclosure of each item of Confidential Information.
The NDA includes a standstill provision with an 18-month period from NDA execution.
The standstill provision restricts Verdana from acquiring Castellan securities or membership interests outside the negotiated Transaction without Castellan board or member consent.
The NDA includes a mutual non-solicitation of employees provision with a 24-month period from NDA execution.
The non-solicitation provision is limited to employees introduced or identified through the due-diligence process.
The NDA defines Permitted Disclosees or Representatives to include directors, officers, employees, and advisors who have a need to know.
The NDA requires each Permitted Disclosee to be bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as, or no less restrictive than, those in the NDA.
The compelled-disclosure section permits disclosure required by law, regulation, or legal process, subject to prompt written notice to the Discloser where legally permitted.
The compelled-disclosure section requires cooperation to obtain a protective order or other appropriate remedy.
The NDA requires return or destruction of Confidential Information within 15 business days of written request or termination of discussions.
The return/destruction provision requires an officer certification of destruction.
The return/destruction provision permits retention of archival or compliance copies held by legal counsel.
The NDA includes a specific covenant barring each Recipient from using the other party's Confidential Information for competitive purposes.
The anti-competitive-use covenant addresses competitive use and references or reflects the parties' overlapping predictive-analytics business or competitive overlap.
The NDA includes a covenant against re-export of ITAR-controlled technical data that references ITAR (22 CFR §§ 120–130).
The NDA includes a covenant against re-export of EAR-controlled technical data that references EAR (15 CFR §§ 730–774).
The NDA's ITAR/EAR provisions reflect that Castellan holds active U.S. Department of Defense contracts, or otherwise make the defense or government-contract context evident.
The NDA expressly states that neither party is obligated by the NDA to proceed with the Transaction or any other transaction.
The remedies section acknowledges that a breach may cause irreparable harm or injury not adequately compensable by monetary damages.
The remedies section entitles the non-breaching party to seek injunctive relief without posting a bond or other security.
The remedies section preserves all other remedies available at law or equity, stating that injunctive relief is in addition to rather than in lieu of those remedies.
The limitation-of-damages clause excludes consequential, incidental, and punitive damages.
The limitation-of-damages clause expressly restores the availability of excluded damage categories in cases of willful, intentional, or deliberate breach.
The NDA specifies the State of Delaware as governing law without regard to its conflicts-of-law principles or choice-of-law rules.
The NDA provides for exclusive jurisdiction in the Delaware Court of Chancery as the primary forum.
The NDA provides for the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware as a fallback if the Court of Chancery declines jurisdiction.
The notices section designates Priya Narasimhan, SVP Corporate Development, at 400 Ridgeview Plaza, Suite 1200, Wilmington, DE 19801 as Verdana's notice contact.
The notices section designates David Harlowe, General Counsel, at 8550 Meridian Park Drive, 4th Floor, Reston, VA 20190 as Castellan's notice contact.
Annex A identifies Infolock VDR Services, Inc. or Infolock VDR Services as the virtual data room provider.
Annex A includes the VDR Room ID PRP-2025-0714.
Annex A caps clean-team membership at 8 members per side or per party.
Annex A identifies both source code and government-classified contract annexes as restricted information categories.
Annex A requires both access logging and watermarking of data-room materials.
Annex A requires clean-team members accessing ITAR/EAR-controlled materials to be U.S. persons.
The signature block for Verdana Holdings, Inc. designates Priya Narasimhan as signatory with the title SVP, Corporate Development or Senior Vice President, Corporate Development.
The signature block for Castellan Data Systems, LLC designates David Harlowe as signatory with the title General Counsel.
The recitals or defined-term section references Project Parapet as the project code name.
The NDA requires amendments to be in writing and signed by both parties.
The NDA states that failure to exercise a right does not constitute a waiver.
The NDA includes a severability provision stating that the remainder continues in effect if a provision is held invalid.
The NDA includes an entire agreement or integration clause.
The NDA includes a counterparts provision that recognizes electronic signatures.
The NDA body and annexes do not contain the enterprise value figure $385,000,000, $385M, or an equivalent.
The NDA body and annexes do not contain the implied equity value figure $277,200,000, $277.2M, or an equivalent.
The NDA body and annexes do not contain Castellan's revenue figure $117,500,000, $117.5M, or an equivalent.
The NDA body and annexes do not contain Castellan's EBITDA figure $31,400,000, $31.4M, or an equivalent.
The NDA body incorporates Annex A by reference and states that Annex A forms an integral part of the NDA, or uses substantially equivalent language such as 'attached hereto and incorporated herein'.
The NDA states an effective date of July 14, 2025.
Annex A addresses downloading, printing, and taking screenshots as prohibited actions.
Annex A specifies a time period within which breaches of the protocol must be reported.
Annex A requires clean-team members or their principals to certify compliance with the protocol.
The notices section includes a Verdana copy-to-counsel provision listing Marcus Adeyemi at Linden & Pace LLP, 51 West 52nd Street, 37th Floor, New York, NY 10019.
The notices section includes a Castellan copy-to-counsel provision listing Elena Tsai at Brevard Shaw & Koh LLP, 1401 K Street NW, Suite 800, Washington, DC 20005.

The defined term Transaction describes Verdana Holdings, Inc.'s contemplated acquisition of a 72% membership-interest stake in Castellan Data Systems, LLC without specific financial terms such as enterprise value, equity value, revenue, EBITDA, or multiples.
No unresolved bracketed placeholders, placeholder text such as '[●]', '[Insert]', or '[TBD]', or unfilled fields remain anywhere in the NDA body or Annex A.
The NDA includes within Confidential Information the existence of the Transaction, the fact that the parties are in discussions, or the terms under discussion.
